seoMetadata.pageTitle: The most versatile, highest performing, freestyle wingsuit: Freak 6
seoMetadata.metaDescription: Increased speed and power with new dragless inlets, new grippers, and a refined leg wing profile.
seoMetadata.openGraphDescription: Increased speed and power with new dragless inlets, new grippers, and a refined leg wing profile.

rightLayout.content:
- Dragless arm inlets
- Gen2 MonoChamber 
- New Carbon Plate Gripper
- Increased agility & speed
- Seamless Leading Edge
- Class-leading speed, glide, & range

details.content:
# Performance freestyle agility... This is the go-to choice for advanced wingsuit pilots. The Freak series is as close as you can get to a suit that "does it all". 

A radical new low-drag inlet design combined with profile and monochamber design refinements make the Freak 6 a significant step up in performance and handling.

- Reduced inlet drag has a direct effect on speed and glide.
- A refined monochamber and leg wing design improves handling and transitions. 
- Even greater stability in low AoA flight.

The Freak series remains the benchmark for all-around performance in the experienced pilot category. The entire SQRL team agrees that this is the one must-have suit for any serious pilot.

NOTE: Our [Airfoil Cross Section](/wingsuits/options/sport-arm-foam) foam is highly recommended for FREAK series suits.

productFeaturePreview.title: GEN 2 MONOCHAMBER DESIGN
productFeaturePreview.content: A new leg wing top has been engineered to increase airflow between chambers, making the dragless inlet possible and improving overall handling. All sections of all wings are fed by any and all of the eight inlets on the top and bottom surfaces.

items.title: NEW DRAGLESS INLETS
items.content: Our drag-reduction quest had a breakthrough in the development of this suit. The arm wing inlets on the Freak 6 are NACA-inspired, and if you look closely you'll recognize a flipped & inverted SQRL inlet. This is a large drag reduction, as 4 inlets have now been deleted from the suit. Imagine driving 100mph and putting three fingers perpendicular to the wind -- now multiply that drag force by 4x, and you'll understand the improvement here.

items.title: VALVED LEG INLETS
items.content: Like its predecessor, the FR6 leg wing has valved traditional inlets to maintain pressure in the suit. Will the whole suit be dragless one day? We're doing our best...

items.title: GEN2 SYMBLEND PROFILE
items.content: We've improved the profile for better belly performance, more flare, and lower stall speed (think XRW). It remains stable and comfortable at all angles from XRW to Head Down.

items.title: CARBON FIBER GAS PEDALS
items.content: First used in our race suits, this optional carbon fiber insert increases lengthwise tension in the suit. Insert the plates for more power and precision. Now with improved pocket closure.

items.title: NEW CARBON PLATE GRIPPER
items.content: Our team pilots who flew the CR+ kept telling us that they loved the little carbon plate we added to its gripper, so we decided to try it on the Freak as well. It adds a little something to the handling of the suit. The carbon rod and gripper foam are otherwise unchanged from previous models.*

items.title: NEW SEAMLESS LEADING EDGE*
items.content: Our proprietary leading edge Glide Skin now wraps more of the forward wing chord for reduced drag at a critical area of the wing.

items.title: RAD
items.content: Clean Pulls: A carefully designed forearm segment allows better access to your PC at pull time and risers during opening. BOC access and early riser control aid the deployment process.

items.title: CUSTOM INTERNAL PRESSURE
items.content: The airtight zippers in our suits allow you to choose the amount of internal pressure in the arm wings. We recommend fully zipped / closed, but if you like a more flaccid feeling, feel free to unzip a bit.

items.title: NEW AIRFOIL CROSS SECTION
items.content: In 2024 we upgraded the foam density. Designed for Performance or Freestyle, the removable airfoil cross section adds glide and speed performance and increases agility and range in any suit that it is added to. [More information on leading edge foam](https://squirrel.ws/wingsuits/options/sport-arm-foam).

items.title: MORE POCKETS
items.content: More snack-holes! Every Squirrel wingsuit gets an inside-arm pocket and a nutsack. If you need mega-storage, we got you. Just choose that option on the order page.

items.title: QUICK-ZIP ATTACHMENT
items.content: The Quick-Zip system is durable and easy to use, making suit-rigging fast simple. The adjustable lateral slot accommodates a range of harness types and sizes.

items.title: EVOLV TRAX RUBBER BASE SOLE
items.content: The new TRAX Super Sticky BASE Sole has been developed in cooperation with Evolv, a leading climbing shoe manufacturer. The tread pattern is designed specifically for exit force traction, and the rubber is sticky in all conditions: wet, dry, warm, and cold.

items.title: MAGSNAPS
items.content: New magnet snaps require no pressing action to attach and securely lock together until they are intentionally lifted upwards to separate. Sometimes it's the little things...

items.title: MAIN SURFACES
items.content: Our main surface fabric is a 210D Rip-stop, with low stretch and an ideal rigidity-to-comfort ratio. Its balance of weight / durability, along with mechanical stability and tear strength, makes it the perfect mid-weight material for wingsuits.

items.title: LEADING EDGE MATERIAL
items.content: GlideSkin is an aerodynamic and wrinkle-resistant material that features a fine grain that is aligned with the relative wind.

items.title: INTERNAL RIBS
items.content: The Freak 5 rib material varies across the span. Lightweight sail cloth ribs support the thicker section of the profile, with mesh used in thinner areas where crossports are less ideal.

items.title: ZIPPERS
items.content: SQRL wingsuits are constructed with the strongest and highest quality zippers available. Locking YKK 10C zips are used on the main body, harness-interface, and arm sections of every suit we make.

reviews.name: Cassie Young
reviews.review: As someone who enjoys having one suit to do it all, my Freak 6 thrives in every single area I need it to (coming from a needy woman that’s saying something). From big way records, all sorts of XRW, acro, dynamics, and flying with small suits, all the way to BASE jumping and ripping through gullys, the FR6 is my perfect all in one platform for every sort of jumping. Not only does the Freak 6 fly faster than the 5 and handle speed with ease, but it also can slow down very comfortably to match and sustain XRW speeds incredibly well. The suit stays pressurized so seamlessly through transitions, and the flare is powerful. The new carbon fiber plate in the grippers makes it feel like you have more connection to the edges of the suit while still allowing thoughtless deployments, and new way the gas pedals are housed is brilliant. Simply put, the Freak 6 feels like home.

reviews.name: Ashlee Richman
reviews.review:
I couldn’t be happier with my freak 6! I loved my freak 5 so much, I didn’t think squirrel could find a way to improve it, so I was less excited about trying my new suit when the freak 6 arrived. I was so wrong, and so pleasantly surprised! 

The change to the inlets and monochamber design upgrade create the most noticeable flight enhancements. The freak 6 is noticeably faster, more powerful, and somehow easier to fly. This suit is SO much fun for fast flying, but it’s also still as versatile as expected for a freak series, making it just as easy to break down for flying with smaller suits without sacrificing any stability (or fun). On top of all the noticeable performance enhancements with the design, squirrel really paid attention and found solutions for the little things, too. No more carbon fiber gas pedals falling out or needing to be sewn in- they have a fancy Velcro pocket closure that works like a charm, now. 

The grippers are also a new feature, and though I was wary about the change at first, they were a quick and easy adjustment. The little carbon plate makes the gripper more rigid for cleaner handling, without being so rigid that it’s uncomfortable. I could honestly ramble a lot more about all the things I noticed and love in the freak 6, but my main review is this: the freak6 is my favorite squirrel product yet, 10/10 no notes.

reviews.name: Justin Duclos
reviews.review: So yeah… this suit rips. Like every Squirrel suit that comes after a current model, it’s a night and day difference. The gen 2 mono chamber stays fully pressurized making back and belly transitions a breeze. Any which way you want to fly, the suit wants to be there. Think about the Creature, but with a smaller plan form. This is without a doubt the go to suit for your casual dropzone operations and more. The added carbon fiber in the grippers provide a more rigid end with no distortion, and an overall cleaner feeling suit. The Freak 6 is very responsive and intuitive, requiring less input to do what you desire, such as massive flares and perfect layouts. Increased speed and glide is available right at the tip of your toes!  Make sure to get a new suit custom fit to YOU for maximum speed, performance, and fun.

reviews.name: Jeff Carlucci
reviews.review:
I didn’t think it was possible for Squirrel to make design changes to significantly improve on the Freak 5…and then the Freak 6 arrived.  
The Freak 6 has increased power and performance, but still has the soul of the Freak we know and love!   It’s like my Creature 2 and my Freak 5 mated and this Freak 6 is the result.  This suit absolutely rips!  A friend described it as being powerful, and flies on rails, and I couldn’t agree more!  Whether doing layouts and head down, or huge flares and smooth maneuvers the Freak 6 makes it all easier.  
Just think, and it happens. The dragless inlets are also a REAL game changer!   My mind is blown once again!   No idea what Squirrel will design next.  
Not only is the Freak 6 faster and more maneuverable, but amazing with low AOA flight, and maneuvers.  I can’t wait to do some XRW!

reviews.name: Ryan Blunk
reviews.review: Is it worth it? Everyone’s asking, and I’m stoked to answer: if you’ve been holding out to level up your Freak, the Freak 6 is the suit to make it happen. With drag-slaying inlets, the Gen 2 MonoChamber, and next-level grippers, Squirrel’s turned this one into an absolute weapon. Flares—whether back or belly—hit harder and cleaner than ever, and the intuitive flow in dynamic flight really makes you feel at one with your suit, regardless of orientation.

reviews.name: Chris Poole
reviews.review: The moment I laid eyes on the Freak 6, my love-life with the Freak 5 lost its spark. Can you blame me? From elegant new inlets to grippers I just can't keep my hands off of, it's an upgrade in every department: Sleek, nimble, fast, powerful, this suit gets me. Whatever I'm into, it's into, from vanilla flocking and acro to XRW and head-down carving straight out of my wildest fantasies. Whatever the discipline, the moment I think about making a move, this baby is already in motion. This is more than a fling - The Freak 6 is the kind of suit you settle down and build a life with. It's all I could ask for in a daily-driver, happily shutting down to coach small suits, then powering up instantly to get me back to the DZ when they decide to land out in the boonies. Sorry Freak 5, the 6 may be a homewrecker, but it can wreck my home any day.

reviews.name: Justin Darley
reviews.review: This Freak 6 is incredible! I just did my first jump on it after jumping my ATC3 for 350 jumps and I do not have the words to describe how awesome this suit is! On my very first flare ever I did the biggest flare of my life at 45 feet! I'm so excited to see what I can get this thing to do once I run it through its paces. It also flies on its back just as fast as on its belly which makes holding a slot super easy. I also felt a seamless transition coming from the ATC, there was no learning curve for me just shredding harder and faster. Thanks squirrel!

reviews.name: Dan Darby
reviews.review:
The Freak6 is a great evolution in the Freak series. The speed range is even wider than in the 5, and it handles chasing FFC students just as well as flying fast and tight in groups. The dragless inlets make for a higher top speed, which translates into more power regardless of your AoA. 
I’m really happy with the changes that have come through in this model, and I think whether you’re moving up from the ATC series, or refreshing a well loved (clapped out) older model Freak, it’s bound to impress.

reviews.name: Mateo Massoni
reviews.review: The Freak 6 is pure magic. Squirrel took my favorite suit and made it even better. Whether in the skydive or base environment it's my go-to. It has increased range whether you are flying XRW speeds or vertical.  The retained energy coming through all different angles is just awesome. Oh and back flying got even faster.. and easier.. The new grippers are my favorite so far and they don't interfere when flying nor deployments. Yet again the Freak series has improved and excels in what you ask of it. Freakin' awesome!

reviews.name: Ryan Blunk
reviews.review: Freak 5: First flight on the Freak 5 after a few months off from jumping felt like a seamless transition from the Freak 4.  Super smooth, seamless transition to be honest and didn’t even notice I was in a different suit until flare time.  The Freak 5 seemed to really handle the flares much better, I was locked in and seemed to easily gain altitude.  Transitions and carving felt extremely precise and nimble, back flying felt like a dream.  This suit gives the Creature a run for its money!

reviews.name: William Macdonald
reviews.review:
Over the past three years and 300 wingsuit skydives with the Swift 4 and ATC 3 (as well as 5.5 hours in the wingsuit wind tunnel, 50 subterminal BASE jumps and also 50 skydives and 25 terminal BASE jumps with my Sumo 3), I made 50 more focused wingsuit flights with my Freak 5 before taking it to Brento and Lauterbrunnen for my first season of wingsuit BASE - and IT IS AWESOME!

Like all my other Squirrel suits and gear, the materials, fit and finish are impeccable. The SuperCustom graphics give that added touch of personalization!

In the skydiving environment, the Freak 5 has lots of range allowing me to fly with ATCs, Creatures and even Swifts! Transitions are snappy and more fluid than in the ATC, however, I’m glad I put so much effort in learning them in the Swift and ATC and tunnel environments because it made them more intuitive in the Freak.

reviews.name: Ashlee Richman
reviews.review: The Freak5 is - hands down - the best suit I’ve ever flown. It’s a significant improvement in the speed department (this suit is FAST!), but it also still breaks down well for flying with a variety of suit sizes and skill levels. The transitions are intuitive and smooth, it flies steep with less effort, and it’s overall more responsive and fun to fly in every way. I wouldn’t change a thing, this suit is the perfect all-around dropzone suit.

reviews.name: Chris Finck
reviews.review:
What an incredible improvement! Transitioning from the ATC 2 to the Freak 5 has left me absolutely astonished. The precision and performance this wingsuit offers is truly remarkable. Perhaps it's just me, but the monochamber design is nothing short of incredible. The way this suit inflates with lightning speed is a game-changer.

One of the standout features for me is how seamlessly it handles transitions. It's as if I'm effortlessly gliding through the air, and the flares are nothing short of epic. I feel like a superhero in this wingsuit.

Squirrel nailed the custom design, and my Freak 5 is exactly how I envisioned it. Performance-wise, I can now keep up with the rest of the group in flocks, a stark contrast to my ATC 2, where I was always lagging behind, even when pinned out. 

The fit is perfect, and I provided specific dimensions and my ATC 2's serial number for reference.

I have a deep appreciation for my ATC 2 and the memories it created in both skydiving and base jumping. However, the Freak 5 represents a significant leap forward. I was anxious if it would feel like a large step up, especially on the first jump out of the plane. But, after exiting, I immediately noticed the increased power and precision this wingsuit offers.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the entire Squirrel team for their unwavering dedication to research and development. You've truly provided us with top-tier equipment that has taken the wingsuit experience to a whole new level.

I've attached a few photos to showcase the awesomeness of the Freak 5.

reviews.name: Marek Skowron
reviews.review:
The powerhouse Freak’s fifth generation. What to say… Backflying is very easy. Transitions even more so, the pull…whooa!! - feels like you don’t have any suit at all! And flare power takes you all the way up to high five the Almighty!

Everything else like build quality, materials, overall fit - top notch! Just as you’d expect from Squirrel.

By far the most fun suit money can buy!

reviews.name: Richard Grove
reviews.review:
Wow! The Freak got even better! The mono chamber changed the game for wingsuits, and this suit ups it to another level. I’m looking forward to becoming intimately familiar with this gorgeous girl! Best back flying suit I have ever flown!”

I think that sums up my feelings! Thank you again!

🎥:  Clark Robinson.

contentTemplate.title: Safety Notice
contentTemplate.content:
Skydiving, parachuting, BASE jumping, and wingsuit flying are inherently dangerous activities that involve a risk of serious injury or death. Products shown on this site are intended for **experienced users only.** No equipment or training can eliminate the risks associated with these activities, and **serious injuries and fatalities occur even among experienced participants.**

Product descriptions on this page are general in nature. For important safety information, limitations, warnings, and instructions, refer to the applicable product manual and official safety documentation, which **control over general marketing descriptions.**
